title: Gift Registry Entry Item Price Leaderboard
dataSources: Gift registries (`gift:registry`), Amazon wishlists (`amazon:wishlist`), holiday card sends (`holiday:card`), birthday budgets (`birthday:budget`), and thank-you notes (`thankyou:note`).
app: Gift registry exports, Amazon wishlist snapshots, holiday card mail logs, birthday budget trackers, and thank-you note reminders ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gift:registry item_price_usd=*
| stats sum(item_price_usd) as total_value, avg(item_price_usd) as avg_value by event_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks event values by total and average item price across gift registry entry events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `item_price_usd` values for each gift registry entry event and review total and average item price by event.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total item price.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which event shows the biggest item price numbers in your gift registry entry data.
